record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, normalize log1p training-item counts by their 95th percentile among observed items, clamp to [0,1], then apply the incumbent square root. Retain zero features for unseen items and attenuation 1-0.3*feature. Robust normalization may prevent a few exceptionally frequent items from compressing the frequency feature for most histories. Use training interactions only; preserve embeddings, backbone, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, normalize log1p training-item counts by the 95th percentile among observed items, clamp to [0,1], then retain the square root and existing attenuation. This may reduce compression from exceptionally frequent items. Unseen items remain zero, and the existing checkpoint buffer carries the feature into prediction without architecture or predictor changes.
